text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Brian, you're so cool after all!!
Kyaa, look over here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...If we leave now, we might make it in time
for the Shinkansen one train earlier than scheduled."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
Hurry up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Still, Narita Brian's performance this time was truly magnificent."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we keep this up, we might be able to
get a good result in the Tenno Sho (Spring) too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Trainer!
choice_data_list: Sorry, I was just lost in thought...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... *tsk*.
This is all your fault.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa. Today's race was the absolute best~!
Hey, are you running in the Tenno Sho (Spring)?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring), huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Rumor has it the 'Jet-Black Assassin'
Rice Shower, with her black hair and blue rose, will be running too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Is that one strong?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Like, on the level of crushing the legendary feats
of Mihono Bourbon and Mejiro McQueen? Seriously insane.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Still, we're rooting for you, Brian!
You've gotta win, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Rice Shower, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, regarding training from tomorrow onward,
I'd like you to adjust it for the Tenno Sho (Spring).
choice_data_list: You're registering for the Tenno Sho (Spring), right?
You're entering the Tenno Sho (Spring), right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. She's strong enough that people are whispering she's an "assassin." I'd love nothing more than to face her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"No, merely crossing swords is not enough.
I shall go further and claim victory."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yes. Well then...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Water, water...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Black hair with a blue rose...
The girl matched the description of
the "Jet-Black Assassin" I had just heard about.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-Hyep!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? U-Um, well...
I-I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What part of that makes her an "assassin"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A petite girl who hardly fits
the moniker of the "Jet-Black Assassin."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, at the Tenno Sho (Spring), Narita Brian
would witness her true strength firsthand—
